summary: Show the revision publisher and exact source provenance separately from the run requester

replay.detail: Existing signed publication, requester and source-provenance claims are not rewritten.

schema.detail: No client-v0 schema inputs or generated clients change. Attribution is CLI-local presentation using existing claims and the existing optional provenance field.

rules.detail: Requester ownership, authorization, schedule-holder gates and retirement behavior remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Human mission show and follow output identifies the admitted revision publisher, origin, publication time and claim separately from REQUESTER. Attribution reads the indexed run creation receipt and its admission_publication by claim ID, never mission publication history. Exact-revision source provenance shows the recorded commit and decision or evidence links, including a pull request when recorded. Follow caches these immutable results, including unavailable metadata, once per shown revision. Missing historical provenance is explicitly unavailable, never inferred from the requester or the latest revision.

downtime.detail: No migration or manual database edit is required.

manual.detail: This change only presents recorded evidence. Missing historical source evidence must be supplied by the authoritative publisher, not guessed by readers.

recovery.detail: Swap-back preserves all authoritative publication and requester records.
